notes.briish: A Scottish mill since 1797, weaving and knitting cashmere in Elgin and Hawick.
notes.craft: Johnstons names two mills it operates: Newmill in Elgin (vertical weaving: dyeing, blending, spinning, teaseling on one site) and Eastfield Mill in Hawick (knitwear), and states 'We make what we sell'. Every PDP sampled says Made in Scotland and names 'our Hawick Mill' as the knitter. The maker and the brand are the same thing.

cities: No store of its own in the US · department stores and independent menswear shops, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned_d: Two named owned mills on the brand's own site: Newmill, Elgin (visit-us/elgin page calls it 'Scotland's only vertical weaving mill'; 'Everything from dyeing and blending to spinning and teaseling happens in one location') and Eastfield Mill, Hawick (visit-us/hawick: 'now creating our unique range of knitted garments'). Heritage page: 'We make what we sell and have proudly been Made in Scotland for over two centuries.' Mill tours offered at both sites.
craft_evidence.countries: Scotland 3/3 (sample of 3 PDPs: knit bomber jacket, knit shirt, jumper - all men's knitwear; scarf PDP attempt 404'd). Collection pages say 'knitted in Scotland' (men's knitwear) and 'crafted in Scotland' (scarves). Small sample, knitwear-heavy.
